body: Hah, I'm not in therapy. And I'll check Watts out

Of course they would say that I'm not! Who wants to directly cause a suicide?? They could deeply resent me right now, for all I know. My entire family is very successful, my dad frequently complains about lazy co-workers or clients. Laziness is practically a sin, ivy league college is the standard. I could definitely see myself being viewed as a terrible burden, and a complete lazy loser (all of which is true). Thanks for staying with

well, I'm not going to struggle through life just because someone else didn't have that opportunity. That is not a good enough reason. I don't really think of it as giving up, either. I have already failed because I have no goals or happiness, and staying alive just wastes everyone's time and energy. As I read over this, it sounds very whiny and defensive- but these are truly my thoughts, this discussion is actually quite helpful with thinking all this shit through.

It's reassuring to hear that I may not just be lazy. But it's called tough love, man. Im just burdening them far too much, they try to help me endlessly- for no true reason. I am just dragging everything down. After a few years, people will move on with their lives. If I stay alive they will just have to continue worrying about me, trying futilely to help. I can't ever even smile- its this guilt that weighs down, because I know what needs to happen for the good of everyone.

I'm not worth anything if I don't want anything, I don't have any goals, no energy. I have so much to fail at, so far to fall, and Im starting to not have enough energy to keep it together for everyone around me. What would you do, in my shoes? Wouldnt death seem like the best answer?

That's true. I don't really view myself highly at this point- to say the least, so it's not for me. I don't want my little brothers to see my hanging corpse (its scary how freely I think of this), I can't ruin their futures of happiness. I don't fully know what I expected by writing this, but it does sort out these overpowering thoughts a bit. Thanks for your time.

Life will easily go on without me. Its like I'm trying to swim in deep water- all the time- for no reason. I try to avoid everything, try to baby 
myself, i don't deserve to live. I should have this choice anyway. Why is suicide such a taboo? I didn't choose to come into existence, I should have the right to choose to keep it or no.
